03 · Ordering

Three steps, No forms

NO FORMS
01

Pick from the menu

Open a scent, choose a size, add it to your cart. Mix bottles, ittars and testers freely.

02

Send one message

Tap order and your cart opens in WhatsApp as one clean, ready-written message. Nothing to type.

03

Confirm with the house

The house confirms your order with you on WhatsApp. Pay cash on delivery, or online through EasyPaisa, whatever suits you.

04 · Questions

Before you Ask

Every scent comes in four sizes: a 50ml bottle, a 30ml bottle, an Ittar, and a Tester. The millilitres are marked on every size pill in the menu, and each size carries its own price.

An ittar is a concentrated perfume oil, worn with a dab rather than a spray. A tester is the small, low-price way to try a scent before the full bottle; testers start at Rs 400.

Add your scents to the cart and tap Order on WhatsApp. Your full order opens as one ready message. You can also message the house directly on WhatsApp at 0324 8337940.

Two ways: cash on delivery, or online through EasyPaisa. You arrange it with the house when your order is confirmed on WhatsApp.

Yes. Call Murtaza Ali at 0322 8290045, or WhatsApp Manan Wasaya at 0324 8337940.
